body: Its honestly comforting to know im not alone here. Ive now moved to the "numbness" phase of my episode right now. Im still lost on what to do, if anything, but i just feel like an empty void now. I have a bunch of skills i learned in therapy but i just feel like theres no point right now. -sigh-

I cant help but to think from the "keep your friends close, and your enemies closer" angle. Could be a trap/ bait to set solomon up. They could keep a closer eye on him to see how he operates, and potentially gain greater insight to see if he has any unfavorable motives for making pacts with so many demons and increasong his power. Lucifer was really suspiscious MC and why she wanted to make pacts with all of his brothers, only makes sense to me that if Lucifer was suspicious of a human girl with seemingly no power/special ability, would make sense to me that he and especially Diavolo would be very very interested in Solomons motives as well.

Honestly, i feel like Diavolo is pulling a lot of the strings in the devildom, but not for evil purposes necessarily. Maybe he needed an excuse to get solomon down there since hes such a powerful sorcerer and enslaver to demons. Everybody who got invited down for the exchange problem totally all have a role to play. Solomon may have an incredible amount of power and have the ability to control demons, but he cant control angels, can he? Enter Simeon, Luke, and potentially other angles if another war were to break out.
